_comment: Cards that exist only for the block-tax test (tests/unit/combat/test_block_tax.py). Never part of a deck list; loaded by the test registry fixture alongside data/cards/. `t_block_toll` is the unconditional tax; `t_tithe_angel` is Archangel of Tithes' shape, both statics gated on its own combat state.

cards.name: Test Block Toll
cards.oracle_text: Creatures can't block unless their controller pays {1} for each of those creatures.

abilities.text: Creatures can't block unless their controller pays {1} for each of those creatures.

cards.name: Test Tithe Angel
cards.oracle_text:
Flying
As long as this creature is untapped, creatures can't attack you or planeswalkers you control unless their controller pays {1} for each of those creatures.
As long as this creature is attacking, creatures can't block unless their controller pays {1} for each of those creatures.
